text:
Naked they have fallen,

the eleven chimes.


The speckled hens

peck at the trees' shadow,

and a swarm of bees

goes grumbling above.


Morning

has broken its necklace from the tower.


On the trunks, the cicadas scratch themselves.


Behind the garden fence,

slipping,

still,

your white parasol.

translation.title: Naked They Have Fallen...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the clipped still-life of sound, shade, insects, and the white parasol.
